data.revised_prompt: A vertical 2:3 background illustration for a mobile Three Kingdoms pixel arcade game, viewed from a fixed frontal battle camera. Interior of a Chinese ancient military stronghold camp: large command tent centered in the far background, several canvas tents and wooden palisade structures to the left and right, banners, brazier fires, stacked crates and weapon racks, warm dusk firelight, layered depth, strong central focal point. The foreground center must be an open camp ground with NO ROAD, NO PATH, NO ROAD MARKINGS. Pixel-art arcade style, crisp hard silhouettes, limited palette, high contrast, painterly detail forbidden, no characters, no text, no UI, no frame, no modern objects.
